nodes.label: ic_launcher.webp (xxhdpi Android launcher icon)
nodes.rationale: 144x144 px Android launcher icon for the xxhdpi density bucket of the OPC mobile app. The image shows the stock Android placeholder icon (white Android robot head silhouette on a teal grid background inside a rounded square), indicating the app is still using the default Expo/Android template launcher icon rather than a custom OPC brand mark.
